name: crdm
description: CRDM — the requirements methodology: how a feature request becomes agreed, signed-off requirements. Its seven skills — three governing the methodology, three detailing a single phase (needs assessment, the requirements template, impact analysis), and one for eliciting requirements from a recorded walkthrough; its eight diagrams live in the layer's own `processes/`. RELOCATED 2026-09-22 from `methodologies/crdm/` on the owner's "dont bury sub-graph assets", which also brought this package into skill QA for the first time: bean `lps0` measured that `kg-audit`'s `skillFiles()` walks a hardcoded `skills/`, so while these three sat under `methodologies/` they were silently outside it — and `check:skills` had never validated this manifest, which is why it was missing every field below.
